Landed on main. The spec already REQUIRED this: L1.md 3.1 says the server MUST emit TERMINAL_CLOSED to every client subscribed to the Terminal, and 5.1 says ATTACH_TERMINAL registers the caller as an output subscriber with no session ATTACH required. So a conformance defect, not a missing requirement -- but the requirement lived in the intersection of two sentences in different sections, which is how the hole survived, so 3.1 gained a paragraph stating the union explicitly. Cause: the pane-EOF watcher resolved mailboxes via ClientTable::attached, which only session-scoped ATTACH populates, so an ATTACH_TERMINAL-only consumer resolved to no mailbox and was dropped. Content still flowed (the per-pane pump owns its own clone), so the symptom was an agent watching a pane that simply went quiet forever. Fixed by capturing per-Terminal mailboxes, following the existing event_subscriptions/metadata_mailboxes precedent; exactly-once is structural since the fanout resolves one mailbox per deduped ClientId. No wire change, no feature bit. Federation needed no relay change -- hub/relay.rs already handled inbound TerminalClosed and simply never received one.

Landed on main. FAIL-OPEN authorization bug: ServerState::detach removed the negotiated HELLO layers, and client_layers defaults to LayerSet::all() for an unknown client -- so an L1-only peer that attached and detached began PASSING the proto.md 11.5 out-of-tier gate. Proven on the wire by mutation, not by reading: the reverted run answered a non-L3 consumer's GET_METADATA with a real MetadataValue. Second half, PeerIdentity, fails closed -- a local peer that had merely detached got PermissionDenied from SHUTDOWN's UnixSocket gate. Neither is recoverable in-connection: a second HELLO is a protocol error and PeerIdentity is stamped by the transport before the client task spawns. Root cause is that a mid-connection DETACH does not end the connection -- it emits DETACHED and keeps reading, deliberately -- yet teardown discarded connection-scoped state alongside attachment-scoped state. Fixed by splitting the two: detach is attachment teardown only, and a new forget_connection runs from the single accept-loop site every transport funnels through, which also fixed the force-detach call sites in attach.rs/commands.rs without touching them. What correctly resets was left alone (metadata and event subscriptions, input leases, output pumps). No wire change. One bead clause was STALE -- the testkit has negotiated a real L3 HELLO since #364, so the requested test rework was unnecessary; only a lying module comment needed correcting.

Routing is the eventual answer but not a 1.0 change: it needs a METADATA_CHANGED return leg re-tagging Terminal(Local) -> Terminal(Satellite), a decision about what Global/Group scopes mean across a federation boundary, and -- to be worth having -- federated APPLY_INPUT (phux-2en, post-1.0).
